card.name: Spots before plasma, milk, or assay methods
card.fires_on: Short joining or opening marks (such as 'or', 'and', '(', ':') and parts of 'plasma' where a body-fluid, milk, or lab-method word is likely to come next. Seen in lab-test and breast-milk sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Before milk or fluid terms
modes.description: Small words or brackets right before a type of milk or a body fluid.
